desc:
Team up with up to 3 friends and defend your base from endless waves of toilets!

⚔️ Place and upgrade unique units, including powerful Titans!
🎰 Summon rare units from the banners. Every drop rate is shown
🗺️ Fight through 3 maps and vote your difficulty: Medium, Hard or Apocalypse
👹 Take down huge bosses at the end of each run
♾️ Endless Mode: how many waves can you survive? Climb the seasonal leaderboard!
🔁 Trade units with other players
🎁 Daily rewards, quests and playtime gifts
🍀 Boost your Gold and Luck

Pick your squad, place your towers, and flush them all!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game!
